username.what: The name of your panel account.
username.who: Everyone who signs in. The first admin account is created during installation (named admin unless set otherwise); admins add other accounts in Settings.
username.effect: Must match exactly, including upper and lower case. A wrong name and a wrong password give the same error, so the panel does not reveal which accounts exist. Your account's role (admin, operator or viewer) decides what you may change.

password.what: The password of your panel account.
password.effect: After 10 failed sign-ins within 15 minutes from one IP address (for IPv6: one /64 network), further attempts are refused until that window passes. A sign-in lasts 24 hours and is not extended by use; after that you sign in again.

network.what: Chooses the VPN network whose devices the Nodes page and the firewall's full tunnel section show.
network.who: Operators with more than one network.
network.effect: New devices are created in the selected network. The choice is saved in this browser only; nothing changes on the server.

language.what: The language of the panel: Azərbaycanca or English.
language.effect: Changes only the panel's text. The choice is saved in this browser; other users and the server are not affected.
